newsitem.title: KAZAKHSTAN: Russian troops kill three on Tajik-Afghan border.
newsitem.headline: Russian troops kill three on Tajik-Afghan border.

text.p: Russian border forces have killed three people trying to cross the Tajik-Afghan border, a Russian military spokesman said on Thursday.
He said the three were killed on Wednesday.

"Two were killed as they tried to cross the Moskovsky border section from Afghanistan into Tajikistan," the spokesman told Reuters by telephone from the Tajik capital Dushanbe, saying 40 kg (20 lb) of unspecified narcotics were found on the bodies.
He said the third person was killed trying to cross from Tajikistan into Afghanistan. He gave no further details.
Several thousand Russian troops guard the former Soviet republic's borders under a bilateral agreement with Dushanbe and see their role as a bulwark against fundamentalist Islam to the south.

Islamic opposition guerrillas operated out of bases in Afghanistan during Tajikistan's bloody four-year civil war, although a ceasefire with the embattled government has held since December. However, Tajikistan remains an active transit route for drug traffickers.
